facts.statement: The genus name Kuszholia means "Milky Way bird" based on the Kazakh term for the Milky Way.
facts.quote: Kuszholia (meaning "Milky Way bird" after the Kazakh term for the Milky Way, құс жолы qus jolı) is the name given to a genus of primitive birds or bird-like dinosaurs from the Late Cretaceous.

facts.statement: Fossils of Kuszholia were discovered in the Bissekty Formation within the Kyzyl Kum desert of Bukhara Province, Uzbekistan.
facts.quote: Fossils were found in the Bissekty Formation in the Kyzyl Kum desert of Bukhara Province, in Uzbekistan

facts.statement: The fossils were described by Russian paleontologist Lev Alexandrovich Nesov in 1992.
facts.quote: These fossils were described by Russian paleontologist Lev Alexandrovich Nesov in 1992.

facts.statement: The fossils consist of vertebrae from an animal estimated to be chicken-sized.
facts.quote: described as vertebrae from a "chicken-sized" animal

facts.statement: Kuszholia lived during the Coniacian stage of the Late Cretaceous, between 89.8 and 86.3 million years ago.
facts.quote: The fossils date to the Coniacian age or stage of the Late Cretaceous, in the geologic timescale, between 89.8 ± 1 Ma and 86.3 ± 0.7 Ma (million years ago).

facts.statement: While some suggest Kuszholia were coelurosaurs near the ancestry of birds, most scientists classify them as avialans, specifically primitive ornithurans or enantiornithines.
facts.quote: Kuszholia were possibly coelurosaurs close to the ancestry of birds, although most scientists have considered the fossils as belonging to an avialan (either a primitive ornithuran or enantiornithine).

facts.statement: Kuszholia has been placed in the clade Patagopterygiformes.
facts.quote: Later, Kuszholia was placed in the clade Patagopterygiformes.

facts.statement: A separate family, Kuszholiidae, has been erected for the genus.
The genus contains only a single species, Kuszholia mengi.
facts.quote: El género contiene una sola especie, K. mengi

facts.statement: The Paleobiology Database records the time range for Kuszholia as the Turonian, between 93.9 and 89.8 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Turonian to Turonian (93.9 to 89.8 million years ago)

facts.statement: Kuszholia is classified within the parent group Ornithurae.
The Spanish taxobox lists the unranked family as Enantiornithes.

rejected.statement: The animal is known only from a series of small vertebrae featuring prominent hollow chambers known as pneumaticity.
rejected.quote: It is known only from a series of small vertebrae, with prominent hollow chambers (pneumaticity).
